THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: three continuous fields on a 64x64 periodic square: cell density b, an attractant a made by the cells, and a nutrient n eaten by the cells; all start uniform at 1 plus small noise. Rules (dimensionless): (1) b diffuses and drifts up the gradient of a with strength 11.1*b/(1+b^2) and up the gradient of n with strength 14*b/(1+b^2); cell number is conserved; (2) a diffuses 2.5 times faster than cells, is produced at rate b and decays at rate 1; (3) n diffuses 0.75 times as fast as cells, is consumed at rate 0.084*b*n and resupplied at rate 0.084 everywhere.
